title: Main track chain and loudness make-up measured with the engine; --no-measure
description:
## Intent

The master: its effects, the final limiter, the loudness make-up.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/master.rs`: `Timeline.master.effects` as devices on the main track, then a Limiter (−1 dB when the score has none), then a Utility for the make-up gain, in the engine's order (`crates/apricity-engine/src/master.rs`).
- `crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs`: measure the make-up gain with the same code as `apricity render` (`render::render` → `makeup_db`) and pass it in `SetOptions`; `--no-measure` skips it with a warning. The crate itself never renders.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` and `cargo test -p apricity-cli --test export_cli` — "The master in the set" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): master chain and loudness in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
